integrity: The equations and asymptotic bounds have a self-contained reconstructed mathematical proof. Standalone computation checks small cases only. The scientific assessment is same-model; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires both bipartite parts of size at least two and distinct edge labels; fixed finite-field order for asymptotics. Counts embedded linear operators rather than conjugacy classes; the source graph construction and general derivation properties are prior work. Exhaustive small-field tests are not infinite proofs. Publication priority is assessed from inspected sources and is not independently certified.
title: Rank-polynomial and characteristic collapse for idempotent derivations of complete-bipartite graph Lie algebras
